operations.title: Theta completion is a multiplier, not a discrete zero operator
operations.statement: The exact theta/Poisson kernel whose Fourier transform is Xi defines a bounded self-adjoint convolution operator unitarily equivalent to multiplication by Xi(t). Since the real zeros of nonzero entire Xi have measure zero, the L2 kernel is trivial; zero is continuous rather than point spectrum. The operator is noncompact and translation-compatible spectral quotients cannot promote measure-zero generalized Mellin waves to discrete eigenvectors.
operations.scope: Falsifies direct translation-invariant theta convolution and its translation-compatible reducing quotients; does not exclude non-translation-invariant boundaries or canonical systems.

operations.title: Theta multiplier nullspace and compactness hostile test
operations.description: Fourier-diagonalize the theta convolution, compute its L2 nullspace from the zero-level set, and test compactness on a positive-measure multiplier band.
